name: WS2812B 16 LED ring (Adafruit NeoPixel Ring 16, product 1463 footprint), white RGB 5050, 5 V
author: Adafruit Industries
price_note: assumed for the Sparkleiot 5 pack (listing price not read), one ring used

dims_mm.source: read from the vendor STEP with build123d (17 solids: board 44.45 x 1.6, hole from the board volume 1216.1 mm3 = 31.75, 16 LEDs 5.0 x 5.0 x 1.7 centred on r 19.0)

electrical.data: WS2812 single wire DIN from the Pi (PWM/SPI GPIO, 3.3 V logic into a 5 V part: works in practice, a 74AHCT125 level shifter is the safe fix)
electrical.current_note: about 290 mA white with brightness capped near 30 % (about 18 mA per LED); full white is up to 960 mA (Adafruit: 60 mA per pixel); the rotor budget carries 300 mA at 5 V

step_header: 1463 16x NeoPixel Ring.step, PRODUCT '16x NeoPixel Ring v3', 2018-07-07, author videopixil, Autodesk Translation Framework
why: I032 (2026-10-28): Sawyer switched from the 850 nm Spinel IR ring to a normal LED ring 'just to be safe', Amazon preferred, must have a model. The Amazon generic 16 LED WS2812B rings (Sparkleiot 5 pack B0C77XPKSL, listed 45 OD / 32 hole; Stemedu 2 pack B0BY8Z9L92) share the Adafruit NeoPixel Ring 16 footprint, so the Adafruit STEP is the model.
notes: the Amazon ring is the same footprint as the Adafruit ring (44.5 vs 45 OD, 31.75 vs 32 hole); pad layout and silkscreen may differ, unmeasured
